summary: American Rebel Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing multiple exchange agreements converting preferred stock and debt into common equity. On August 24, 2026, it exchanged 9,600 Series D preferred shares for 72 Series E shares ($72,000), then those for 602,491 common shares. Separately, it settled a $787,500 term loan with Agile Capital for 1,333,111 shares at $0.1125 per share, fully satisfying the debt. A Note Exchange with Streeterville Capital is referenced. These debt-for-equity conversions suggest balance-sheet restructuring, likely dilutive to existing shareholders. Watch for further dilution, potential going-concern disclosures, and the terms of the Streeterville exchange.
